title: Test fixtures leak native Codex child processes
description:
Observed while implementing dotfiles-reinstall-usb-infrastructure-sau.49 (managed runtime recovery). The committed inventory selects Codex v2.5.0 plus local patches, verified integration HEAD 8f7b2dd07cf1b89310ed092eddff95fbef75c1a3 and candidate 72b6af2963dee2a9.

Reproduction: fresh Debian trixie container; no host HOME or credentials mounted; npm ci --ignore-scripts, npm run typecheck, then ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --no-file-parallelism --retry=0 through the existing runtime verifier. Native calls use the locked test dependency. Source/native artifacts are carried from the exact accepted receipt, not rebuilt from moving branches.

Observed failures: 512-task/6-GiB container produced 6 failed tests + 49 EAGAIN spawn errors; 4096-task/6-GiB container with init passed all 2302 assertions but had one unhandled EAGAIN; 4-CPU-affinity/4096-task/6-GiB run had 3 failures + 7 unhandled errors, pids.events max=265 and no OOM kill. No runtime was promoted.

Root cause evidence: src/__tests__/acp-test-utils.ts:createTestFixture starts a real Codex child for every call, registers removal of its temporary HOME only when it exits, but does not register process teardown. CodexAcpClient.test.ts beforeEach creates a fixture for all 122 tests, even tests creating additional/mocked fixtures; its afterEach only unstubs environment variables. Native processes/threads accumulate within the test file.

Evidence retained in /home/lotso/dotfiles/install/out/runtime-recovery-20261105.DELftc: check.py, check.sh, container.log, container-2.log, container-3.log. The original live selections remain untouched. Do not bypass checks, add retries to hide this, patch source from dotfiles preloads, or publish branches. Fix lifecycle in this source repository, then explicitly consume a locally committed test-only patch in the runtime inventory after approval.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every real fixture child and connection is shut down after its test, including failure and multiple-fixture paths.
- A regression observes child termination and temporary-HOME cleanup, not just bookkeeping calls.
- Full pinned suite succeeds without EAGAIN/task-limit events on a credential-free bounded fresh root.
- No production behavior or live runtime selection changes; dotfiles recovery can consume the exact source patch after approval.
close_reason: Fixed locally in 3ba335a1ae30ea4929bdbfa3c74df3d08b7c997c (test/fixture-cleanup-2.5.0), only two test files changed. Per-fixture onTestFinished closes stdin, signals and awaits real child/stdio close, disposes the connection and removes CODEX_HOME. Regression failed before the fix and observes actual cleanup for multiple fixtures, beforeEach and throwing tests. Full pinned integration passed in a credential-free fresh Debian trixie container with 4 CPU affinity, 6 GiB RAM and 512 tasks: typecheck; 2303 passed, 1 intentional expected failure, 40 opt-in skipped; build; real native-backed initialization. pids.events max=0; all memory events zero; no EAGAIN/unhandled errors. Evidence: /home/lotso/dotfiles/install/out/runtime-recovery-20261105.DELftc/{fixture-regression-before-2.log,fixture-regression-after.log,verify-fixed.log,container-fixed.log}. Dotfiles inventory consumes exact patch; host live selectors unchanged; no publication. Windows and authenticated opt-in model tests were not run.
